intent: A compact booking selector with date cards, available time slots and explicit timezone context, using native radios for reliable keyboard selection.

layout.direction: Keep a focused time chooser: a 30px Instrument Serif heading, compact duration/timezone metadata, a row of date cards with 30px day numerals and 12px month labels, then native time radios in a two-column grid, with 12px horizontal and 8px vertical cell insets so long labels clear the border. Preserve neutral surfaces, restrained rules, a clear selected border and the quiet selected-time footer. Use at least 44px controls and non-shrinking clock/globe icons.
layout.container: Size to the parent with @container. Keep the root width at 100%, capped to the focused component, with 24px desktop and 16px narrow padding.

typography.metadata: 12px timezone, duration, weekday and month labels
typography.heading: font-display or font-serif, 24-36px, tracking -0.035em

motion.entrance: Enter the whole chooser with opacity and an 8px rise over 320ms.
motion.interaction: Each keyed day slot grid enters with opacity and a 4px rise over 240ms. Keep the existing 150ms hover/press/focus treatment for available choices.
motion.reduced: Subscribe to live prefers-reduced-motion changes and stop and settle owned card/grid controls immediately. Remove press transforms for reduced motion.

responsive.rules: Wrap long copy; stack secondary details inside narrow containers; keep any horizontal scrolling local and keyboard accessible.

accessibility: Use native buttons and form controls with visible 2px focus rings.
Provide labels, meaningful states and polite feedback where actions update content.
Keep IDs instance-scoped with useId; support multiple instances and empty custom data.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no automatic action or navigation.

content.defaults: Use the realistic default content from the source; expose content and collection inputs as typed props.

props.name: timezone
props.description: Explicit timezone label. The host supplies correctly converted slot labels.

props.name: days
props.description: Ordered days with stable unique day IDs and stable slot IDs within each day. Weekday, day, month and slot labels are display strings; available:false disables a time. Empty and fully unavailable days have written states.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selection. Undefined enables local state; null clears the selection. Without onChange, controlled radios are read-only while day browsing remains available. Unknown or unavailable selections are not shown as selected.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Synchronous notification with an independent dayId/slotId record after choosing an available time. The host owns controlled acknowledgement and any booking or reservation.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.

avoid: Remote images, fake network success or hidden external dependencies.
Decorative status badges, gradients as filler, low-contrast text.
Unlabelled controls, hover-only functionality, overflow at 320px.
contract: Keep BookingDay, BookingSelection and BookingSlotsProps. Use stable day IDs and slot IDs within each day as React keys so reordering retains focused date/radio controls.

Use undefined value for a local choice, or value with onChange for host control. Controlled radios without a writer are disabled; day browsing remains available. onChange receives an independent dayId/slotId record synchronously, without exposing the stored local object.

Browsing a day is separate from selecting a time. Changing day retains the prior valid selection and its actual day/time receipt until a different available time is chosen. Missing days fall back to the first available day.
Keep native radio-group arrow navigation, Space activation and visible focus. Skip unavailable radios. Refused controlled proposals must not appear selected; null clears the selection.

Only selections that still match a known, available slot render as selected. Empty and fully unavailable days show the same written no-times message; without a valid selection, unavailable views use neutral feedback instead of asking for an impossible choice.

Duration, timezone, weekday, day, month and slot labels are host display strings. Render them without parsing, conversion, automatic sorting or a reservation claim. The host owns booking validation and persistence.
Accept empty/arriving schedules, long labels and independent instances with separate radio names and IDs. Wrap content without document overflow.
